Stone Wire piece set (wK wQ wR wB wN wP bK bQ bR bB bN bP): line-art derivatives of the app's own Stone set in
vendor/pieces-stone/, generated by tools/build-wire-pieces.mjs (same silhouettes and cues, redrawn as ink outlines:
White hollow, Black solid with a paper hairline). Like the Stone set, they are part of Ghostlap Roma and may be used and
changed with it under the same terms as the rest of the app's own code.
